reviewer: Flow-Cut owner, independent source-only reciprocal review
checks: Expanded-root radius and credit are transported from the same short-phase output. Residual credits are literal old credits; root spare, reserve and future remain per-root functions.
The selected-root equivalence transports high-root eligibility and each reserve inequality without replacing high and weak reserves by a uniform value.

One reindex_paid_short_long_inputs call supplies the exact paid-short witnesses, expanded branches, remaining component paths/masses, degree-two property, original residual adjacency, prior connector union/internality and original-edge bill. The heavy constructor consumes these witnesses directly.

The final original edge sum and retained-credit inequality concern the original host B and exact fresh/prior connector union. Every old branch is contained whole in one next branch via disjointness, nonempty old branches and the literal union representation.

Finite reindexing retains original carriers and credit sums. Clamping the radius by the uniform cap selects an already available intrinsic walk certificate and decreases, rather than increases, the required max-radius/baseline credit.

The actual four-phase selection wrapper derives the root budget from actual high-root retained credit and weak-root radius-plus-half-credit; it constructs the paid short result under the explicit nonempty-root condition.
remaining_boundaries: The paid-short consumer and class-specific actual-selection wrapper are separate matching interfaces; the final all-scalar instantiation is not asserted.
Root baseline, numerical reserve/scale inequalities, initial family/geometry and nonempty selected roots remain explicit.
Empty-root route, global scale hierarchy and weighted lightness theorem remain open, as do runtime and whole-paper completion.
publication_and_full_ci: Separate future gates; no full CI claim from this source review.
